name: Alva
description: Resource planning PWA for teams: Gantt, capacity and risk analysis on Blazor WebAssembly and .NET 10.

paragraphs: Alva is a web application (PWA) for strategic task planning and team resource balancing. It helps you distribute the workload across people as well as possible — without busywork — highlight the risks of slipping deadlines and show at once why the team is falling behind.

Core pieces: flexible task assignment (people, sub-teams and roles), a two-dimensional Gantt (by task and by assignee), capacity and risk analysis, sprint auto-balancing and a full directory of participants.
Demo: — runs entirely in the browser, no server required.
features: Planning — projects (M:N with teams), sprints, an unlimited task tree, change history, FS/SS/FF/SF
dependencies, assignment to a person, a sub-team or a role.
Gantt — full-width axis, lanes, rollup, critical path, links, drag and drop, zoom and virtualization;
Capacity — work schedules with exceptions and recurring blocks, spreading an estimate over available
